privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy & Video Architecture
privacyPage.subtitle: At AeroTouch, our core principle is mathematical: Your camera stream never leaves your device memory buffer.
privacyPage.pillar1Desc: No video frames, still images, or camera recordings are ever uploaded to any server, cloud provider, or third party. Video frames exist only temporarily in volatile client RAM during HTML5 canvas rendering.
privacyPage.pillar2Desc: The neural vision model (gesture_recognizer.task) and Google MediaPipe runtime are compiled into WebAssembly (.wasm) binaries stored directly in your browser CacheStorage and executed by your local CPU/GPU.
privacyPage.pillar3Desc: By default, all custom gestures, sessions, and settings reside strictly in your browser private IndexedDB database. Optional Supabase cloud synchronization transmits only coordinate metadata (never video) and requires explicit account creation.

helpPage.title: Help & User Guide
helpPage.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AeroTouch, offline gesture models, and user privacy.
helpPage.onDeviceDesc: AeroTouch utilizes a locally hosted Google MediaPipe Gesture Recognizer compiled into WebAssembly (.wasm) alongside the float16 gesture_recognizer.task model stored directly in this application /public folder.
helpPage.localProcessingDesc: Webcam video frames never leave your browser sandbox or memory buffer.
helpPage.zeroCloudDesc: All 21 hand landmarks and 3D bounding geometry are computed on your device.
